pages.text:
Trotec Laser
Products
Laser engraver
Speedy 400 – Trotec's fastest laser engraver & cutter
The Speedy 400 is designed to meet the highest demands in professional engraving and cutting, offering unmatched performance for a wide range of materials and applications.
Why choose Speedy 400?
Dual-source flexibility: CO₂ for organic materials and fiber for metals and plastics, all in one machine thanks to Flexx Technology™.
Industry-leading speed: Up to 4.32 m/s (170 ips) for maximum productivity.
Large working area: 1016 x 610 mm (40 x 24 in) for big projects and batch processing.
Seamless connectivity with Ruby®: Trotec's laser software enables cloud-based job management, remote access, and seamless integration for ultimate productivity.
Smart features: InPack-Technology™, OptiMotion™, SonarTechnology™, and HDLR Technology™ ensure precision at top speeds.
Request a demo Downlaod brochure

Connected solution
Ruby® seamlessly connects the laser machine, exhaust, laser materials , service and support into a cohesive system maximizing efficiency.
Durability meets quality
Rely on the robust construction, high quality components for long-term durability, Speedy lasers ensure consistent, high-quality results even in demanding production environments.
Endless possibilities
Flexx Technology™ combines CO₂ and fiber lasers in one machine, enabling you to process a wide variety of materials. Whether you’re working with metals, plastics, or organic materials, Speedy lasers offer unmatched versatility for any application.

Safety
SERVICE OPERATION
Service activities may only be carried out by authorized, trained service technicians. If side panels and covers are
removed and protective devices are bypassed, this can result in direct and indirect scattered radiation. Service
operation is declared to be laser class 4 and appropriate precautionary measures must be taken (see chapter "Laser
classes of this machine").

Speedy 400 400 4200
The exhaust connection on the side of the machine is used as the measuring point for volume flow and pressure.
Pressure losses through hoses or pipes or filters in the exhaust system must be determined and taken into account when
selecting the exhaust system.
A powerful exhaust system prevents a reduction in the service life of the lenses and mechanical components, the cutting
quality and the laser power acting on the workpiece caused by vapors and dust remaining in the machine.
Notice
The exhaust power available for the application will be reduced by e. g. bends, small hose diameters and
long hoses.
You should therefore note the following:
– Avoid bends.
– Keep hose as short as possible.
– Use hose diameters as large as possible.
Applications generating large amounts of dust or fumes may require a stronger exhaust system. Use of
separate exhaust systems for head and table exhaust may also be necessary.
In this case it is absolute necessary to consult your distributor.

Checking the emergency stop button:
1. Press the emergency stop button
– Interior lighting is switched off
– LEDs on the membrane keyboard are switched off
– Axes are freely movable
2. Release the emergency stop button
